objectives.text: Find the card with one orange star that is 4 tiles from a short green house that is next to a tall grey house.
Find the card with two black circles that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is beside a short red house.
Find the card with one green plus that is 4 tiles from a rock that is 2 tiles from another rock.
Find the card with two green circles that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house that is beside a tree.
Find the card with one black square that is beside a short green house that is beside a tall grey house.
Find the card with one black heart that is next to a rock that is beside a short blue house.
Find the card with one red square that is 4 tiles from a tall red house that is beside a tree.
Find the card with one green heart that is 3 tiles from a rock that is next to a tall blue house.
Find the card with one orange circle that is 3 tiles from a rock that is next to a tall blue house.
Find the card with two green squares that is 3 tiles from a rock that is 2 tiles from another rock.
Find the card with one orange square that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is 3 tiles from a short blue house.
Find the card with two orange stars that is 3 tiles from a short grey house that is 3 tiles from a rock.
Find the card with one black diamond that is 2 tiles from a tree that is next to a tall blue house.
Find the card with two blue plusses that is 3 tiles from a short grey house that is beside a tall blue house.
Find the card with two green hearts that is next to a short red house that is next to a short grey house.
